# Set up environment and load data 
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)

# Load data
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Data_Description")
year_agecat_df <- read.csv("CAL_YR_AGEDYS.csv")
year_agecat_df <- year_agecat_df |> 
  mutate(Age_cat = ifelse(AGEDYS<=7, "EOD", 
                          ifelse(AGEDYS<=89, "LOD", "VLOD")))

# Import tree
setwd("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Phylogenies/EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC")
Fasttree_VLOD_DP <- read.tree("Fastree_DP.tre")
```

# Plot by age cat
```{r}
ggplot(year_agecat_df, aes(x = Age_cat, fill = Age_cat)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(
    stat = "count",
    aes(label = paste0("n= ", ..count..)),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Counts by Age Category",
    x = "Age Category",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  guides(fill = "none")      # This removes the fill legend

```

# Plot by continuous age
```{r}

ggplot(year_agecat_df, aes(x = AGEDYS, fill = Age_cat)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Age of Onset (days)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  guides(fill = "none")  

library(dplyr)
year_agecat_df <- year_agecat_df %>%
  mutate(week = (AGEDYS - 1) %/% 7 + 1)  %>%
  mutate(week = ifelse(week ==0, 1, week))

ggplot(year_agecat_df, aes(x = week, fill = Age_cat)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "Age of Onset (weeks)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  guides(fill = "none")


```

# Plot by year
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Calculate total counts per year
total_counts <- year_agecat_df %>%
  count(CAL_YR)

ggplot(year_agecat_df, aes(x = CAL_YR, fill = Age_cat)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(
    data = total_counts,
    aes(x = CAL_YR, y = n, label = paste0("N=", n)),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE     # prevents fill from being mapped in this layer
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Counts by Age Category per Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")+
  guides(fill = "none")  
```
